description: Checksums: CRC32/CRC32C/CRC64/CRC16/Adler/Fletcher/FNV/Murmur3/xxHash32 — Compute non-cryptographic checksums offline for text= (UTF-8), hex= (bytes, spaces/colons ok) or base64= (standard or URL-safe). 22 algorithms with catalog-verified check values: crc32 (zip/gzip/PNG), crc32c (Castagnoli, iSCSI/GCS), crc32_bzip2, crc32_mpeg2, cksum (same number as the Unix cksum command), crc64_xz (ECMA-182), crc16_ccitt_false, crc16_xmodem, crc16_kermit, crc16_modbus, crc16_arc, crc8, adler32, fletcher16, fletcher32, fnv1a_32, fnv1a_64, fnv1_32, murmur3_32, xxh32, sum8, xor8. Optional: algo= comma list (default all; aliases like crc, crc64, murmur, xxhash), seed= for murmur3/xxh32, expect= a hex or decimal value to verify -> MATCH/NO_MATCH with the matching algorithms (handy for identifying an unknown checksum). Each result gives hex and decimal. Limit: bytes x algorithms <= 600,000. For MD5/SHA digests use /v1/security/hash. Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_checksum
